text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with Neo 
Universe—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*crunch*)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――? Impact... Did it... "invade"...?

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Aah! You stepped on the mountain I made, 
didn't you!? We were gonna play sand-pile 
collapse with that!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Yamakuzushi"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, right? 'Reconstruction'... 
I'll do it swiftly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After rebuilding the sand mound— Neo 
Universe quietly observes the children as 
they begin playing sand-mountain collapse.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that a "game"? ..."Dark Matter".
choice_data_list:
...If you're curious, want to give it a 
try?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Affirmative. Executing "trial."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Settings are: 'Mountain', 'Branch'... 
Turn: 'Excavation'...'Lodging'——'GIO'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Control” the turn. Parameters: intensity, 
altitude, scale...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally this is done in groups, but... 
she seems to be analyzing it with all her 
might, so I decided to watch over her for 
a while."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Excavation"... "Phase E." "Parsecs" until 
"collapse"—2, 1, 0.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Confirmed 'Branch' 'lodging'. Analysis of 
'UNDY'— 'Landslide' complete... 
However..."

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Yay, I win~~!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――? They're "laughing"... Is that... an 
"IVO" of "fun"...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "MYS"... cannot "observe".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe has 'detected' this in the 
past, too. 'Sharing' it is... 
difficult..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Difficulty sharing... Does that mean even 
as a child, she sometimes couldn't 
understand when others around her were 
having fun?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, once you properly experience the 
real joy of having fun, you might come to 
understand.
choice_data_list:
This'll be a lot more fun if we do it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""MUTX"? That is... I want to "test" it."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—! Non-strategic "ACTION"... I performed 
"Surprise".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
However, with the "THRF"... at its current 
strength, the optimal parameter for 
"excavation" is—about this much.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
! "Maintaining" at a "microparticle" 
level... This is difficult, but... with 
this—
choice_data_list:
We're cutting it close... Alright, this'll 
have to do!

We're cutting it close... Okay, this'll 
do!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slam—)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's Neo Universe's "victory," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
But... the "development" was unexpected. 
So this is the "Landslide"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Dark matter." I understand the 
"structure," but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Fun" is beyond comprehension... Is it 
because Neo Universe is "different" from 
everyone else...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No... I see. Neo Universe must have felt 
this sense of being 'out of sync' ever 
since she was little."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Fun" really is "incomprehensible," isn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Neo Universe muttered those words, a 
faint hint of loneliness seemed to seep 
into her face.
choice_data_list: Let's learn about it together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you don't quite get it after one 
try, if you keep at it, you might 
gradually understand it better."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Do you... think so...?
choice_data_list:
I'll join you anytime, as many times as 
you like.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Scintillation"— Is this a task for the 
"Trainer"...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not part of my job, but I'll 
accompany you as much as you like. If it's 
for Neo Universe's sake— When I tell her 
that, she blinks her eyes again."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Observation" is proving difficult... 
Trainer is also "unidentified." Very 
mysterious, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."UNDY". Entrusting "JEM" to the 
"retry".
choice_data_list: Let's play like this a lot!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "MUTX"... A lot...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Fun" remains... "dark matter." However... 
perhaps this too is part of 
"transmission"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, the two of us 
played by drawing pictures and playing 
block-removal games.
